_comment: 走力T90モデルの係数置き場。T90=最初の走行ステップから90ftを直線移動する時間。MLB Statcastモデルは2017-2025全体のleave-one-year-out検証を通過して凍結。NPB+公式名称はSprint SpeedだがMLBとの定義同一性は未確認のためNPBモデルは未較正のまま。

target.name: t90_sec
target.definition: 最初の走行ステップから90ftを直線移動する身体的スプリント時間
target.rating_mapping: NPB reference empirical CDF -> normal score -> 50 + 15z

mlb_sprint_t30_to_t90.evidence: 2017-2025 MLB Baseball Savant, n=4381 player-seasons / 1222 players. Leave-one-year-out MAE=0.0211115s, RMSE=0.0284223s; held-year MAE range 0.0199-0.0246s. Sprint-only MAE reduced by 52.7%.

mlb_sprint_t10_to_t90.evidence: 2017-2025 MLB Baseball Savant, n=4381 player-seasons / 1222 players. Leave-one-year-out MAE=0.0306522s, RMSE=0.0394759s. Sprint-only MAE reduced by 31.3%.

mlb_sprint_to_t90.evidence: 2017-2025 MLB Baseball Savant, n=4381 player-seasons / 1222 players. Leave-one-year-out MAE=0.0446337s, RMSE=0.0554035s; held-year MAE range 0.0408-0.0472s.

npb_sprint_speed_acceleration_to_t90.metric: NPB+ Sprint Speed / スプリントスピード
npb_sprint_speed_acceleration_to_t90.reason: MLB全体ではSprint Speedに10ft/30ft splitを加えるとT90誤差が大幅に減る構造を確認した。ただしNPB+の公開Sprint Speed定義とMLB Statcastの定義同一性、およびNPB側のclean acceleration/T30ラベルが未確認なのでMLB係数を移植しない。
npb_sprint_speed_acceleration_to_t90.required_next_gate: NPB clean acceleration/T30 or trajectory-derived T90 training data

npb_sprint_speed_to_t90.metric: NPB+ Sprint Speed / スプリントスピード
npb_sprint_speed_to_t90.reason: Official NPB+ naming is Sprint Speed, but its public formula/window/aggregation has not been verified equivalent to MLB Statcast Sprint Speed. MLB係数の単位換算移植は禁止。
npb_sprint_speed_to_t90.required_next_gate: More same-player direct overlap or direct NPB T90 labels

npb_top_speed_acceleration_to_t90.reason: Compatibility name only. NPB+ official metric name is Sprint Speed.

npb_top_speed_to_t90.reason: Compatibility name only. NPB+ official metric name is Sprint Speed.

hp1b_avg_to_t90.reason: Season-average home-to-first is repeatable but still mixes swing-to-run transition and batting-side context. Use only after condition/batting-side calibration. Fastest home-to-first is never accepted.

sprint50_to_t90.note: 50m is a prior, not a direct definition of baseball speed. Fukumoto QA prohibits using 50m ranking as a hard cap.

proxy.note: Tier E fallback only. UBR / extra advance / steals / triples are intentionally excluded from base speed.

qa: Fukumoto: 50m/yoidon ranking alone cannot disqualify S; 106 steals cannot create S.
Safety bunt: normal-swing and bunt home-to-first times must not be pooled.
Sprint Speed vs acceleration: 2017-2025 MLB LOYO confirms same Sprint Speed can hide material T90 differences; adding T30 cuts MAE by 52.7%.
NPB+ and MLB both use the name Sprint Speed, but public formula equivalence is not established.
Suzuki Seiya 2022: MLB T90 should be evaluated through the calibrated MLB model/reference path, not direct Sprint Speed -> rating.
